scope: Flat user-mode cpu-clock samples, 997 Hz, forty fresh endpoint processes. Percentages use all recorded sample period, including the Python launcher. They are not wall-time phase percentages.
Profiles and controlled timing experiments have separate runs. Do not subtract profile percentages to estimate elapsed-time savings.
The original profile reports were resolved before the runner rebuild. Their source and installed-input hashes are recorded with the failed full gate. No surviving original runner binary is claimed.
Optimized profiles have a saved binary/source snapshot. Their function names are decoded with unchanged declaration ordering in the matching RMD stage source files.
Every timing experiment has twenty-five randomized paired rounds, one warmup per endpoint, and a paired bootstrap ratio of medians. Final target GCC compilation is outside the timed RMD endpoints.

decomposition.scope: Fresh process endpoints. --check parses/resolves/checks target; --prepare also constructs complete C buffers; --emit-c also writes C+renames. Each root endpoint includes prelude/root evaluation, input capture, DSO loading, and cleanup. Endpoint differences are not isolated phase timers.

experiments.name: no-semantic-interposition
experiments.reason: Inlines RMD functions inside a library whose own references are already bound locally with -Bsymbolic. Significant paired improvement; this experiment alone does not pass the required confidence bound versus GCC.

experiments.name: no-plt
experiments.reason: No established additional gain or passing GCC gate. Not used by the selected library.

experiments.name: precomputed-buffer-end
experiments.reason: No measurable gain over the optimized library.

experiments.name: fresh-function-symbol-map
experiments.reason: Significant slowdown. Exact C/rename bytes match on five controls; native runtime and intrusive outputs pass.
experiments.controller:
import hashlib, importlib.util, json, os, random, re, statistics, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path
ROOT = Path.cwd(); HERE = ROOT / '.profile-cache/source-order-profile'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('measure', ROOT / 'benchmarks/source-order/measure.py')
M = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(M)
os.sched_setaffinity(0, {4})
record = json.loads((ROOT / '.profile-cache/source-order-final.json').read_text())
source = (ROOT / 'stages/c/emit.rmd').read_text()
old = 'fn c_function(stage: *CStage, declaration: *RmdDecl) -> unit {\n    (*stage).next_temp = 1usize;'
new = old + '\n    (*stage).symbols = make CMap {\n        entries: null(*CEntry), count: 0usize, capacity: 0usize\n    };'
assert source.count(old) == 1
candidate = HERE / 'map-emit.rmd'; candidate.write_text(source.replace(old, new))
library = HERE / 'fresh-symbol-map.plugin'; obj = HERE / 'fresh-symbol-map.o'
sources = [candidate if p == ROOT / 'stages/c/emit.rmd' else p for p in M.LIBRARY_SOURCES]
build_commands = [
    [str(ROOT / 'build/rmd-c'), '--library', '--object', '--export', 'c_backend_build', '--export', 'c_program', '--cflag=-fPIC', '--cflag=-fno-semantic-interposition', '-o', str(obj), *map(str, sources)],
    ['gcc', '-shared', '-Wl,-Bsymbolic,-z,text,-z,relro,-z,now', str(obj), '-o', str(library)]]
build = []
for command in build_commands:
    start = time.perf_counter_ns(); p = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True)
    build.append({'command': command, 'wall_ns': time.perf_counter_ns() - start, 'returncode': p.returncode, 'stdout': p.stdout.decode(), 'stderr': p.stderr.decode()})
    if p.returncode or p.stderr: raise RuntimeError(build[-1])
(HERE / 'map-build.json').write_text(json.dumps(build, indent=2) + '\n')
base_library = HERE / 'optimized-baseline.plugin'
if M.BASE.sha256(base_library) != M.BASE.sha256(ROOT / 'build/rmd-c-library.so'): raise RuntimeError('baseline library changed')
# Source stress controls isolate one large local namespace from many tiny ones.
big = 'fn large(x:u64)->u64 {\n' + ''.join(f'var v{i}:u64=x+{i}u64;\n' for i in range(32768)) + 'return v32767;\n}\n'
tiny = ''.join(f'fn small_{i}(x:u64)->u64 {{ return x; }}\n' for i in range(8000))
for name, text in [('big-first', big + tiny), ('big-last', tiny + big)]:
    (HERE / (name + '.rmd')).write_text(text)
workloads = [
 ('ordinary-8000', Path(record['inputs']['ordinary-8000']['sources']['rmd']['path']), True),
 ('intrusive', ROOT/'examples/intrusive.rmd', False),
 ('runtime', ROOT/'tests/runtime.rmd', False),
 ('big-first', HERE/'big-first.rmd', True),
 ('big-last', HERE/'big-last.rmd', True)]
commands = {}; preflights = []
for name, target, is_library in workloads:
    outputs = []
    for route, native in [('baseline', base_library), ('candidate', library)]:
        root = HERE / ('map-' + name + '-' + route + '.rmd')
        M.staged_source(target, root, native)
        response = HERE / ('map-' + name + '-' + route + '.rsp')
        command = [str(ROOT/'build/rmd'), str(root), *(['--library'] if is_library else []), '--emit-c', '--symbols', str(response)]
        output = M.checked(command)
        c_path = HERE / ('map-' + name + '-' + route + '.c'); c_path.write_bytes(output)
        outputs.append({'c': M.file_info(c_path), 'response': M.file_info(response), 'command': command})
        if name == 'ordinary-8000': commands[route] = command[:-1] + ['/dev/null']
    if outputs[0]['c']['sha256'] != outputs[1]['c']['sha256'] or outputs[0]['response']['sha256'] != outputs[1]['response']['sha256']:
        raise RuntimeError('output mismatch: ' + name)
    c_path = Path(outputs[1]['c']['path']); response = Path(outputs[1]['response']['path'])
    M.checked(M.syntax_command(c_path))
    if name in ('runtime', 'intrusive'):
        raw = HERE / ('map-' + name + '-raw.o'); renamed = HERE / ('map-' + name + '.o'); executable = HERE / ('map-' + name)
        M.checked(['gcc', *M.C_FLAGS, '-c', str(c_path), '-o', str(raw)])
        M.checked(['objcopy', '@' + str(response), str(raw), str(renamed)])
        extra = [str(ROOT/'tests/native.c')] if name == 'runtime' else []
        M.checked(['gcc', '-std=c99', '-pedantic-errors', '-O2', '-no-pie', str(renamed), *extra, str(ROOT/'build/librmd0_host.a'), '-o', str(executable)])
        observed = M.checked([str(executable)])
        if name == 'intrusive' and observed != b'intrusive: ok\n': raise RuntimeError('intrusive output mismatch')
        outputs[1]['execution_stdout'] = observed.decode()
    preflights.append({'name': name, 'input': M.file_info(target), 'outputs': outputs})
commands['gcc'] = record['commands']['ordinary-8000']['gcc-original-syntax']
paths = [ROOT/'build/rmd', base_library, library, candidate, Path(__file__)]
for command in commands.values():
    if command[0].endswith('/rmd'): paths.append(Path(command[1]))
hashes = [M.file_info(p) for p in paths]
r = {'commands': commands, 'inputs': hashes, 'production_sources': M.source_hashes(), 'preflights': preflights,
     'build': build, 'cpu': 4, 'rounds': 25, 'warmup': 1, 'seed': 202610017, 'samples': []}
print('Build and five output-equality/syntax preflights passed; runtime and intrusive execution passed.', flush=True)
for command in commands.values(): M.BASE.measure(command)
rng = random.Random(r['seed'])
for i in range(25):
    order = list(commands); rng.shuffle(order)
    for key in order: r['samples'].append({'round': i, 'endpoint': key, 'wall_ns': M.BASE.measure(commands[key])})
if hashes != [M.file_info(p) for p in paths] or r['production_sources'] != M.source_hashes(): raise RuntimeError('input changed')
rows = [{x['endpoint']: x['wall_ns'] for x in r['samples'] if x['round'] == i} for i in range(25)]
med = {key: statistics.median(x[key] for x in rows) for key in commands}
r['median_ms'] = {key: value/1e6 for key, value in med.items()}; r['comparisons'] = {}
for a,b in [('candidate','baseline'), ('candidate','gcc'), ('baseline','gcc')]:
    rng = random.Random(str(r['seed'])+a+b); values=[]
    for _ in range(10000):
        selection=rng.choices(rows,k=len(rows)); values.append(statistics.median(x[a] for x in selection)/statistics.median(x[b] for x in selection))
    values.sort(); r['comparisons'][a+'/'+b]={'ratio':med[a]/med[b], 'paired_bootstrap_95_ci':[M.BASE.percentile(values,.025),M.BASE.percentile(values,.975)]}
(HERE/'map-comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'median_ms':r['median_ms'],'comparisons':r['comparisons']},indent=2))

allocation_model.scope: Local-symbol maps only. Counts follow from the checked three symbols per ordinary function and c_map_set capacity rules; these are calculated requested bytes, not allocator instrumentation.

experiments.name: single-byte-text-copy
experiments.reason: The bounded 8k comparison shows a significant improvement. Exact output, foundation boundary, full normal and sanitizer checks pass. The final all-workload result is archived separately in results.json.

new = '    if count == 1usize {\n        (*buffer).data[(*buffer).size] = *text;\n    } else {\n        rmd0_host_move_bytes((*buffer).data + (*buffer).size as isize, text, count);\n    }\n    (*buffer).size = (*buffer).size + count;'

commands = {}; preflights = []

        command = [str(ROOT/'build/rmd'), str(root), *(['--library'] if is_library else []), '--emit-c', '--symbols', str(response)]
        output = M.checked(command)
        c_path = HERE / ('byte-' + name + '-' + route + '.c'); c_path.write_bytes(output)
        outputs.append({'c': M.file_info(c_path), 'response': M.file_info(response), 'command': command})
        if name == 'ordinary-8000': commands[route] = command[:-1] + ['/dev/null']
    if outputs[0]['c']['sha256'] != outputs[1]['c']['sha256'] or outputs[0]['response']['sha256'] != outputs[1]['response']['sha256']:
        raise RuntimeError('output mismatch: ' + name)
    c_path = Path(outputs[1]['c']['path']); response = Path(outputs[1]['response']['path'])
    M.checked(M.syntax_command(c_path))
    if name in ('runtime', 'intrusive'):
        raw = HERE / ('byte-' + name + '-raw.o'); renamed = HERE / ('byte-' + name + '.o'); executable = HERE / ('byte-' + name)
        M.checked(['gcc', *M.C_FLAGS, '-c', str(c_path), '-o', str(raw)])
        M.checked(['objcopy', '@' + str(response), str(raw), str(renamed)])
        extra = [str(ROOT/'tests/native.c')] if name == 'runtime' else []

foundation = (ROOT/'tests/c_stage.rmd').read_text()
anchor = '    stage.body.size = 0usize;\n    c_number(&stage, 0u64);'
extra = '\n'.join([
 '    stage.body.size = 0usize;',
 '    c_text(&stage, "x");',
 '    var previous: *u8 = stage.body.data;',
 '    var previous_capacity: usize = stage.body.capacity;',
 '    while stage.body.size < previous_capacity {',
 '        c_buffer_end(&stage.body);',
 '        c_buffer_text(&stage.body, stage.body.data + (stage.body.size - 1usize) as isize);',
